Brewers Complete stunning comeback to sweep Dodgers!
Shohei Ohtani's three-run homer gave the Dodgers an early 4–0 lead, but Milwaukee fought back with six unanswered runs to seal a sensational 6–4 win. The Brewers swept the NLCS 4–0 to punch their ticket to the World Series!
